title: Runbook: editor enrollment and Cyclotron lab membership for Papyrus curation (R2)
description:
A one-page runbook (docs/accounts/) for giving a Papyrus site editor the ability to add references through the central Cyclotron lab.

It covers:
1. Editor enrollment: sign in once at the Papyrus site (Google), which links the Google identity to a Prospectus Person.
2. Lab membership: an owner or admin of the Cyclotron lab account (40abda23…) adds that Person with at least the member role. Member grants console:write, which Papyrus maps to review; viewer grants read only.
3. How to verify: the lab's authorize call returns console:write for that account.
4. How to revoke.

No AWS steps beyond the existing UI and API. Note what the Anthus One portal will automate later (invitations, kanbus-b2ddb42).
